basic_details.job_title: Rohini District Court Court Auctioneer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Two (02) positions of Court Auctioneers for Rohini Courts, Delhi are open to members of the Bar who have a standing of at least 5 years at the Bar and a Gross Professional Income of Rs. 6 lakh or more per annum. The Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Rohini Courts, Delhi has invited the applications in pursuance of letter no. 2260/G-2/Genl.I/CA/DHC dated 30 September 2026 from the Hon'ble High Court of Delhi. Applications in the enclosed proforma must reach the office through proper channel, i.e. through its R&I Branch, latest by 28 November 2026, on or before 5.00 p.m.

content_sections.heading: About Rohini Courts Court Auctioneers
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Rohini Courts, Delhi, and signed by Bhupesh Kumar, Pr. Judge (FC), N-W, as Chairperson of the Court Auctioneer Appointment Committee, Rohini Court Complex, Delhi. The two positions are for Rohini Courts, Delhi, and the appointment follows letter no. 2260/G-2/Genl.I/CA/DHC dated 30 September 2026 received from the Hon'ble High Court of Delhi, New Delhi.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applications must reach the Office of the Principal District & Sessions Judge, Rohini Courts, Delhi through proper channel, i.e. through the R&I Branch of this office, latest by 28 November 2026 on or before 5.00 p.m. The documents list asks applicants to have a Diary No. from the R & I Branch, ground floor, Room No. 1, Rohini Courts, Delhi. The application goes in the enclosed proforma, with the supporting documents and a latest coloured photograph. The proforma asks for these particulars: Name Father's/Husband's Name Date of Birth Date of Enrollment as an Advocate with Bar Council of Delhi along with Enrollment No. (attach copy of Enrollment Certificate) Name of Bar Association with which registered, with the Membership No. Residential/Official Address with Contact No. Email Address Court where mainly practicing Reference of two Advocates of ten years standing or of other respectable persons Copy of last two ITRs/other document to show that annual income from such profession is Rs. 6 Lakhs or more per annum Any special reason the applicant wants to adduce in support of his/her application, followed by the signature The notice also encloses a tabular proforma for the post/appointment of Court Auctioneer at Rohini Court Complex, Delhi, with columns for S.N., Name of Applicant/Advocate, Address and Mobile Number, BCD Enrolment No. with date, RCBA Membership No., Annual Income with Proof, Referred by two Senior Advocates, and Remarks.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications for two (02) positions of Court Auctioneers for Rohini Courts, Delhi. Applications are invited from members of the Bar only. The eligibility conditions printed in the notice are: A standing of at least 5 years or more at the Bar. A Gross Professional Income of Rs. 6 Lakhs or more per annum, shown through a copy of the last two ITRs or another document showing that the annual income from the profession is Rs. 6 Lakhs or more per annum. Reference of two Advocates of ten years standing or of other respectable persons. The notice does not mention an age limit, though age proof is among the documents to enclose. The pay or remuneration for Court Auctioneers is not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: The notice lists these documents for applying for the post of Court Auctioneers at Rohini Courts, Delhi: Filled proforma Diary No. from the R & I Branch, ground floor, Room No. 1, Rohini Courts, Delhi One recent photograph (passport size) Experience/Character Certificate issued by RCBA, Rohini Courts, Delhi Copy of RCBA's I-card (self attested) Copy of BCD's I-card (self attested) BCD Enrollment Certificate's copy (self attested) Income Affidavit / ITR Reference of two advocates (10 years standing) with mobile number/sign & stamp Age proof If the RCBA I-card or the BCD I-card (items 5 and 6) is not valid, the fee receipt for the same is required.

rows.details: Rohini Courts Court Auctioneer notice dated 20.11.2026

faq.question: Q1. How many Court Auctioneer posts are there at Rohini Courts?
faq.answer: The notice invites applications for two (02) positions of Court Auctioneers for Rohini Courts, Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Rohini Courts Court Auctioneer?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the office through its R&I Branch latest by 28 November 2026, on or before 5.00 p.m.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for the Court Auctioneer posts?
faq.answer: Members of the Bar who have a standing of at least 5 years or more at the Bar and a Gross Professional Income of Rs. 6 Lakhs or more per annum can apply.

faq.question: Q4. How is the Rs. 6 lakh income to be shown?
faq.answer: Applicants must give a copy of the last two ITRs or another document showing that the annual income from the profession is Rs. 6 Lakhs or more per annum; the documents list names an Income Affidavit / ITR.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for Rohini Courts Court Auctioneer?
faq.answer: Fill in the enclosed proforma, attach the supporting documents and a latest coloured photograph, and submit it through proper channel, i.e. through the R&I Branch, after obtaining a Diary No. from the R & I Branch, ground floor, Room No. 1, Rohini Courts, Delhi.

faq.question: Q6. Whose references are needed with the application?
faq.answer: The proforma asks for the reference of two Advocates of ten years standing or of other respectable persons, and the documents list asks for their mobile number, sign and stamp.

faq.question: Q7. What if my RCBA or BCD I-card is not valid?
faq.answer: If the RCBA I-card or the BCD I-card is not valid, the fee receipt for the same is required with the application.

faq.question: Q8. Where will interview and result updates appear?
faq.answer: Applicants are advised to visit https://rohini.dcourts.gov.in/ and https://northdelhi.dcourts.gov.in/documents/ regularly for necessary instructions, interview, result etc.
